result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. Nothing is committed.

- **Generated HTML (3 rules):** `(html|html|xhtml)` is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator `.htm` pages match.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML:** `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by`:** `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The path patterns are full-match regexes, so the existing matches (`.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle`, `.js` files with the content markers) still apply, and hand-written `.htm`, `.js` or `.xml` files without the content markers stay out of these scopes.

I ran the `SourceFileFilterTest`, `CodeConfigurationTest`, `SourceCodeFilesTest` and `SourceFileTest` classes offline and they passed. I did not add a test that asserts the new matches, and I did not run the whole `codeanalyzer` suite.
